text: Good evening, I'm a childminder and I have little Ilinca (4) overnight while her parents are away for a family thing, so I'm writing on their behalf. Nothing dramatic, I just want to check I'm doing the right things. She hasn't done a poo for three days now. She keeps going to sit on the toilet and then gets off saying nu vreau, nu pot, and she's been quite grumpy and moody about it all evening, stomping around, the usual. Then around half eight she was sick once, just the one time, mostly her dinner. Since then I've given her small sips of water and some diluted apple juice, puțin câte puțin, and she has kept all of it down, nothing else has come back up. I've had a good look at her under the big light in the kitchen and her colour is completely normal, her lips are pink like always, nothing odd there. She's in bed now with her teddy, still a bit cross with the world. I'm thinking it's probably all to do with being bunged up, but I would rather ask than guess. Should I keep going with the drinks and maybe some pear or prunes tomorrow, or is there something else I should be doing tonight? Mulțumesc frumos, sorry it's long.
